title: Population of an administrative unit in one year
description: One record of data/population/population.jsonl (population.csv has the same fields, with age flattened to age_<band> columns). Key: (pcode, year).

method.description: reported: taken from the source for this pcode. sum_of_children: sum of the unit's current children that have data.

children_with_data.description: For sum_of_children: children with data / all children. Below 100% means the sum is a lower bound.

age.description: Total population by five-year age band.
